items.item_text: Graduation from high school or a General Education Diploma and two years of laboratory experience or two years of college including courses in the natural, physical or social sciences and one year of laboratory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Under the supervision of the Principal Investigator, Lab Assistant II will assist with laboratory experiments and procedures, including preparation of research subjects/specimens, tissue preparation and dissection, ex vivo laryngeal studies, and the operation and routine maintenance of laboratory equipment. Lab Assistant II will also assist with maintaining laboratory supplies, work areas, safety records and research documentation; process and organize experimental data; and perform other laboratory support duties as assigned.
This is a limited, part-time appointment that may convert to career.
Perform multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize responsibilities
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Skill to maintain accurate scientific records.
